overview: FSHQ.gg Data-in-Transit Specification defines comprehensive API contracts, event streams, message formats, and external integration patterns for all data movement within the Fantasy Sports Clubhouse platform. This specification covers RESTful API endpoints for Next.js server actions and API routes, real-time event streams for live updates, standardized message formats for system communication, and integration contracts for external systems (primarily Sleeper API). The architecture supports authentication via Supabase Auth, implements Row-Level Security (RLS) at the database layer, and ensures data integrity through comprehensive validation and error handling. All endpoints follow REST principles, use JSON for request/response payloads, and include proper HTTP status codes, authorization requirements, rate limiting, and caching strategies.

validation_rules: statusCode must match HTTP response status
error code must be uppercase snake_case
message must be actionable for end users
nextCursor only present when hasMore is true
data array never null, empty array when no results
Cursors are opaque strings, not sequential integers
signature must verify with shared secret
timestamp within 5 minutes of current time for replay protection
results array length must equal totalRequested
Each result must have either data or error, not both
type 'update' should include 'old' field for comparison
type 'delete' includes only ID in payload
